text: この　カセキは　ぼくが　みつけたんだ　ふたつ　とも　ぼくのだ！

structure.jp: ぼくが　みつけたんだ
structure.en: I'm the one who found them

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and pushes a fact as the explanation. ぼくが　みつけたんだ = 'I'm the one who found them'.

patterns.name: 〜とも
patterns.explanation: とも after a number means all of that many. ふたつ　とも = 'both of them'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one's)
patterns.explanation: の with no thing after it stands for 'the one belonging to'. ぼくのだ = 'they are mine'.
